scenes.name: ONE CLOCK
lines: Four sectors each set their own watch and get a model-internal witness.
四个战场各自校表，各自拿出一份模型内见证。
But nature keeps no separate clocks for gauge couplings and for quark flavour.
可自然界不会为规范耦合和夸克味混合各备一只钟。
So force them all onto one shared clock, with one common set of zero weights.
那就逼它们读同一只钟，共用同一组零点权重。

scenes.name: RESOLVENT CLOCK
lines: The clock is a quadratic resolvent: one operator, read at integer ticks j.
这只钟是二次预解式：同一个算子，在整数刻度 j 上读数。
Each zero becomes a point y; tick j averages one kernel over the weights.
每个零点化为一点 y；第 j 拍用这组权重给一条核函数取平均。
Higher ticks bend the kernel harder, like sharper low-pass filters.
刻度越高，核函数弯得越狠，就像越来越陡的低通滤波器。
Only zeros through three physics windows carry weight; the first is number 8359.
只有三道物理窗口齐过的零点才分得到权重；第一枚是第 8359 号。

scenes.name: FIFTH TICK BREAKS
lines: With one shared weighting, four ticks close; the fifth breaks at every scale.
共用同一组概率时，前四拍精确闭合；第五拍在一切尺度上断裂。
At twenty-two binary digits, every allowed clock lands one code below the reference.
按 22 位二进制读取，所有合法的钟都比参考值低一个码。
A neutral shell reweighting rescues tick five, with just enough efficiency range.
中性壳重加权救回了第五拍：它的效率倍率范围刚好够用。
Then the sixth tick is forced up, by at least 1.33 times ten to the minus eight.
可第六拍随即被迫上移，至少 1.33 × 10⁻⁸。

scenes.name: THE SEVENTH TICK
lines: Now fix those six ticks and ask about the seventh, which nobody fitted.
现在锁住这六拍（第六拍取偏移后的值），去问没有人拟合过的第七拍。
Gauss-Radau quadrature leaves a window two point one four trillionths wide.
高斯–拉道求积只留下一个宽 2.14 × 10⁻¹² 的窗口。
At thirty-five binary digits, that window is one code, 4130 above the reference.
按 35 位二进制读取，这个窗口只占一个码，比参考码高出 4130 格。
A selector that keeps the sixth shift but reports the reference code falsifies the clock.
若一个选择器接受第六拍的偏移，却在第七拍仍报参考码，它就证伪了这只钟。

scenes.name: FORTY-FOUR BITS
lines: Inputs kept to forty-four binary digits force that code by a rational certificate.
每项输入保留 44 位二进制，纯有理数证书就能锁死那个码。
Drop to forty-three, and the same seven real zeros give two different codes.
退到 43 位，同样七枚真实零点就能给出两个不同的码。
Forty-four bits is the exact threshold.
44 位正是精确门槛。

scenes.name: THREE BANDS
lines: The six ticks also squeeze the weights: over 99.931 percent sits in three height bands.
这六拍还挤压了权重本身：超过 99.931% 落进三条高度带。
Roughly 23, 37 and 39 percent, with almost nothing in between.
大约 23%、37% 与 39%，带间几乎空无一物。
Stiffen the edges by one part in ten million: no reweighting hides the drop.
把边刚度加强千万分之一：怎样重排权重都藏不住响应的下降。
On the eight-zero solution, the held-out quark CP invariant J comes out six point zero eight percent low.
在八点解上，留出的夸克 CP 不变量 J 比参考值低了 6.08%。

scenes.name: NO NAIVE SELECTOR
lines: Could a simple rule grow these bands without fitting?
有没有一条简单法则，不靠拟合就能长出这三条带？
Power laws, Gaussian determinants, Gibbs weights, short walks, single-shot selectors: certificates exclude them all.
幂律、高斯行列式、吉布斯三角权、短程相干游走、单次选择器：区间证书逐一排除。
Weights pasted on from outside break at every turn.
从外面给零点贴上的权重，处处触壁。

scenes.name: TWO LEAN FLOORS
lines: Two Lean theorems sit underneath. One caps narrow-band weight by a positive Fourier sum.
底下是两条 Lean 定理。第一条把窄频带的权重压在一个非负傅里叶和之下。
The other floors near-collision mass: less variance forces more collision.
第二条给近碰撞质量垫了地板：方差越小，碰撞越多。
Two equal weights at zero and one, squared: nine is at most about forty.
两个等重的频率 0 与 1，取二次卷积：9 不超过约 40。
Next chapter: look inside the shell.
下一章：转向壳体内部。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter twelve.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十二章
